name: Shieldlock Holmes
source:
The golden cup disappeared! Would you be able to find the culprit? Play as the famous detective Shieldlock Holmes, and find new clues by speaking with witnesses.
[From [url=https://elsakisiel.itch.io/shieldlock-holmes] itch.io[/url]]
translation:
黄金杯失踪了！你能找出犯人吗？扮演著名侦探盾锁克·福尔摩斯，与目击者交谈，寻找新的线索。
（来源：[url=https://elsakisiel.itch.io/shieldlock-holmes]itch.io[/url]）
